name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
steps: Sit on the floor with a foam roller behind you, lie back so it rests across your mid-back, bend your knees, and keep your hips grounded.
Support the back of your head lightly with cupped hands and draw your elbows softly forward.
Keep your lower ribs lightly braced as you exhale and extend your upper back slowly backward over the roller.
Return smoothly to neutral, shift the roller slightly up your upper back, and repeat across stiff thoracic segments.
tips: Keep your glutes resting firmly on the floor and abs lightly braced so extension occurs in your upper back rather than your lower back.
Never place the roller directly beneath your lower back or neck while extending backward.
